description: Guard Preview hooks for Claude Code in the house profile of b7n0de: the plugin proofbundle-guard, which the owner's machines install beside proofbundle; proofbundle alone registers no hook (D134). These commands start the gate with the house's autonomous flag, the opt-in of D125: where the base decision path asks, the autonomous answer asks only for an external effect and denies the rest (D85, D93), and the standing GO for work-branch pushes needs its own consent (D129). Recognized git and gh shell forms can check declared evidence; local evidence is diagnostic only. Unrecognized code-carried operations and unresolved write targets can receive no decision. Level 1 is not a security boundary. The installed git pre-push hook is a separate, bypassable check. Host behaviour after a hook timeout is not measured. The Stop and TaskCompleted hooks run the done check of a declaring repository, and a SessionStart hook hands an open done blocker on (D127). A Read or Grep of a key file is denied (D102). The PostToolUse hooks count a session's open pull requests (D110) and the answered asks (D94).

hooks.command: python3 -I "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/proofbundle_gate.py" --autonomous || { echo 'proofbundle gate: the gate could not run, so the call is blocked' >&2; exit 2; }
python3 -I "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/proofbundle_gate.py" --autonomous || { echo 'proofbundle gate: the gate could not run, so the call is blocked' >&2; exit 2; }
python3 -I "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/proofbundle_gate.py" --autonomous || { echo 'proofbundle gate: the gate could not run, so the call is blocked' >&2; exit 2; }
python3 -I "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/proofbundle_secrets.py" --autonomous || { echo 'proofbundle gate: the gate could not run, so the call is blocked' >&2; exit 2; }
python3 -I "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/proofbundle_gate.py" stop || { echo 'proofbundle done check: the check could not run, so the session does not end' >&2; exit 2; }

out=$(python3 -I "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/proofbundle_gate.py" task-completed) || { echo 'proofbundle done check: the check could not run, so the task stays open' >&2; exit 2; }; if [ -n "$out" ]; then printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; exit 2; fi

python3 -I "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/proofbundle_gate.py" session-start || printf '%s\n' '{"systemMessage": "proofbundle done check: the hand-over could not run, so an open blocker was not handed on; the done check at Stop is unchanged (D127)."}'
